title: BBK BBK Root Wayfinder compact result payload v2
description: Closed compact role-specific result payload for `bbk_root_wayfinder`. Use FULL when material truth cannot fit these fields.

anyOf.description: Baseline ID, revision, digest, lifecycle state, and durable path; null with a reason when no baseline exists yet.

baseline_ref.description: Baseline ID, revision, digest, lifecycle state, and durable path; null with a reason when no baseline exists yet.

work_graph_refs.description: Current capability, phase, work-unit, and worker-invocation references or an explicit not-ready disposition.

blockers.description: Exact technical, authority, decision, capacity, or host-window blockers.

outstanding_user_request_ids.description: Unresolved controller-mediated request IDs, if any.

anyOf.description: The canonical next root for the harness-root controller, or null when no root transition is valid.

recommended_next_root.description: The canonical next root for the harness-root controller, or null when no root transition is valid.

residual_uncertainty.description: Explicit bounded uncertainty that remains after economic stopping.

planning_readiness.description: Current rolling-wave planning readiness record, including planning and architecture mode, roadmap/frontier identities, deferred refinements, and execution-admission truth.

project_coverage.description: Current whole-project capability coverage ledger separating delivered candidate claims from incomplete, blocked, deferred, or out-of-scope project work.

x-bbk-full-detail-triggers: Consequential assurance or protected-floor exposure requires detail beyond the compact fields.
Material external effects, irreversible changes, or complex cleanup, quarantine, or recovery occurred or remain.
Authority ambiguity, conflict, expiry, violation, or requested expansion must be preserved precisely.
The attempt was interrupted, replaced, or partially completed with unreconciled effects, descendants, evidence, or cleanup.
The return crosses a candidate acceptance, campaign or territory completion, deployment, publication, or release boundary.
The parent explicitly requested FULL detail.
Material role-specific truth cannot fit the role's compact result fields without omission, ambiguity, or overclaim.
